write out.example: I wrote out my notes in full to help me remember them.

write up.example: I wrote up the report and submitted it.

wrap one's head around something.meaning: Cố gắng hiểu hoặc chấp nhận một điều gì đó phức tạp
wrap one's head around something.example: It took him a while to wrap his head around the new software program.

wrap your head around.meaning: Hiểu thấu, tiêu hóa hay chấp nhận một khái niệm phức tạp.
wrap your head around.example: Quantum physics is a fascinating subject, but it takes time to wrap your head around its principles.
